mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate a stable economic environment that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 100) reflects strong industrial activity, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is negative or less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140,000) combined with high consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000) signals robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 140,000 and RSAFS > 450,000, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 17,000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 17000) indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 17000, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
